name: amfx-seasonal-cumret-research
description: amFX reproduction (13NOV23 p2): Cumulative return of seasonal trading signals YTD. Original shows Spectra Markets Almanac trades (60.6% win rate, +190% cumulative). This approximation uses SPY with known calendar effects: Halloween (Nov-Apr bullish), Turn-of-Month (last 2 + first 3 days), and tracks cumulative daily returns during seasonally favorable windows vs unfavorable windows.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: CUMULATIVE RETURN OF SEASONAL TRADES (13NOV23 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's 2023 Almanac seasonal signals: 60.6% win rate, +190% cumret
# This approximation uses SPY with known calendar effects:
#   1. Halloween Effect: Long Nov-Apr, Flat May-Oct
#   2. Turn-of-Month: Last 2 + first 3 trading days of each month
# Tracks cumulative daily returns during seasonal windows.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Daily return
prev_close = lag(period=1)(close)
daily_ret = (close - prev_close) / prev_close

# Extract month and day_of_month for seasonal rules
month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(idx)
day = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(idx)

# =============================================================================
# SEASONAL SIGNAL 1: Halloween Effect ("Sell in May and Go Away")
# Bullish: November through April (months 11,12,1,2,3,4)
# Bearish: May through October (months 5,6,7,8,9,10)
# =============================================================================
is_halloween_bull = (month >= 11) or (month <= 4)

# =============================================================================
# SEASONAL SIGNAL 2: Turn-of-Month Effect
# Bullish: Last 2 trading days + first 3 trading days of each month
# Approximation: day >= 27 OR day <= 3
# =============================================================================
is_turn_of_month = (day >= 27) or (day <= 3)

# =============================================================================
# COMBINED SEASONAL SIGNAL
# In seasonal window = Halloween bull OR Turn-of-Month
# =============================================================================
is_seasonal = is_halloween_bull or is_turn_of_month

# Return only during seasonal windows
seasonal_ret = daily_ret if is_seasonal else 0.0
seasonal_ret_clean = seasonal_ret if is_valid(seasonal_ret) else 0.0

# Return during non-seasonal windows (for comparison)
non_seasonal_ret = daily_ret if (not is_seasonal) else 0.0
non_seasonal_ret_clean = non_seasonal_ret if is_valid(non_seasonal_ret) else 0.0

# Buy-and-hold return for reference
buyhold_ret_clean = daily_ret if is_valid(daily_ret) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS (percentage scale)
# =============================================================================
cum_seasonal = cumulative()(seasonal_ret_clean) * 100.0
cum_non_seasonal = cumulative()(non_seasonal_ret_clean) * 100.0
cum_buyhold = cumulative()(buyhold_ret_clean) * 100.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Cumulative Returns — Seasonal vs Non-Seasonal vs Buy-and-Hold
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return: Seasonal Signal vs Buy-and-Hold (SPY 2023)',
    category='Seasonal Returns',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Window', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Non-Seasonal Window', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Buy & Hold', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(cum_seasonal, cum_non_seasonal, cum_buyhold))
